name: 4'-chlorodeschloroalprazolam
summary: 4'-Chlorodeschloroalprazolam is a triazolobenzodiazepine derivative which has been sold as a designer drug, presumably with sedative effects, first identified in Australia and the US in 2021, and subsequently in Ireland.
